notes: Export is always visible on laptop screens: the top bar now fits 1280 and 1366 px wide.
Undo and redo now cover animation, ad settings and linked groups too.
Safer work: a new design no longer wipes your crash-recovery copy, and closing the tab with unsaved changes asks first.
In the timeline, tap Space to play or pause; hold Space to pan as usual.
Every effect is now in the Effects menu, and the Design panel opens the right section for what you select.
New Help topics: Merch, Ads, Build for, Pen and node edit, Textures, Live symmetry, Assets and What's new.
Blank canvas now starts at a safe 4096 px (Maximum is still there).
